prompt: Photorealistic isometric product rendering of a solar-only 1-tonne produce cold store in a sunny farm yard, no text or labels. White 2.4x2.0x2.2m thick PU sandwich-panel chamber bolted to a raised galvanized steel skid with posts and ground anchors, 4 large dark-blue solar panels tilted on roof rails above with airflow gap, front insulated door swung open with rain canopy revealing central aisle. Inside both side walls have galvanized steel racks stacked 5-high with vented plastic crates filled with fresh green and red produce, 50mm air gaps for circulation. High on the rear interior wall a compact DC cooling unit with fan grille and evaporator blowing cold air down the aisle, condensate drain pipe to exterior. Small steel battery cabinet and controller box mounted externally on side wall with black DC cables running from roof array down to cabinet then to cooler. Bright midday sun with soft product-shot lighting, crisp shadows, real materials: glossy panels, matte white steel, galvanized skid, food-grade plastic, fresh produce. Fixed chamber and racks vs moving fan airflow and hinged door, energy path readable from sun to panels to battery to cooler to crates.
must_not: overlaid text, labels, dimensions or scale bars
schematic arrows, circles or diagram symbols
transparent, wireframe or exploded rendering styles
excessive frost, snow or background clutter

visual_plan.view: isometric three-quarter exterior view slightly above with open front door revealing interior aisle, racks and evaporator
visual_plan.spatial_layout: isometric from front-right above: chamber centered on skid, roof array tilted above, open door at front center revealing aisle receding inside, left and right side racks with crate stacks flanking aisle, evaporator high at rear interior, battery cabinet on right exterior side wall, cables routed down from roof, ground anchors below skid
visual_plan.operating_moment: midday staged operation with cooler running, fan blowing cold air over partially loaded vented crates of fresh produce at chill, door open for loading one lot while stored lots remain chilled, condensate draining
visual_plan.transfer_path: sunlight onto roof array to DC cables down to battery cabinet to powered cooler to fan-driven cold air circulating around vented crates and returning to evaporator
visual_plan.interactions: solar panels bolted to roof rails on skid posts; chamber bolted to raised skid; door hinged to chamber compressing gaskets; battery cabinet wired to array and to cooler; cooler mounted to chamber wall blowing across racked crates; crates stacked on side rack shelves with guard rails and central aisle for airflow; condensate draining outward
